title: MV [HUD MAKER ] Is there any way to change the HUD after the player enters another room?

posts.author: Murkmia
posts.body:
Hello everyone I'm new to rpg maker and I'm trying to learn everything here a little bit
A question about HUD MAKER in Rpg Maker MV
I'm trying to find at least some answer to the question on various forums, but after scrolling through them I didn't find much, or I didn't fully understand.
I want to make 2 different HUDs. If the player moves to another room, the HUD could change. (The first HUD in digital design, but when the character moves to another map, the HUD changed to a school design)
Some say that this can be done somehow using switch (Which I don't understand much yet), but even if I did, I do not know where to get scripts from the plugin code to remove or replace images in HUD
Maybe someone here has used Hud Maker and knows it well? or does he guess how to make a HUD change?
I will be glad of any help!

posts.author: caethyril
posts.body: I haven't used HUD Maker myself, but maybe you could just make all the elements for both HUDs, then hide/show those elements when appropriate? E.g. when switch 1 is on, show the "school" portrait, HP bar, clock, or whatever, but hide the "digital" stuff.

posts.author: ShadowDragon
posts.body:
to extend caetryril answer
if you use 2 huds,  (school + digital)
you can bound a switch (OFF for school digital, ON for school or vice versa)
so on each image of the hud you place
$gameSwitches.value(4)
this means, if switch is true, show it, alternative to make it cleaner
$gameSwitches.value(4) === true   // for school
$gameSwitches.value(4) === false  // for digital
so you can use those to switch between HUDS.
if you want it to hide it as well, use 2 switches
1 for school, 1 for digital,  ON is showing while FALSE is hiding completely.
